facts.text: “Magnetic” by The Bausa is in its 32nd week in the Dutch Top 40.
“Dracula” by Tame Impala is in its 56th week in the US Hot 100.

“Mr. Brightside” by The Killers is in its 529th week in the UK Top 100.
